ANGKA KECEPATAN (Tengah)  int16_t xPosCenter = 12;   while (*text != '\0') {    charWidth = mx.getChar(*text, sizeof(cBuf) / sizeof(cBuf[0]), cBuf);    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < charWidth; i++) {      mx.setColumn((MAX_DEVICES * 8) - 1 - xPosCenter++, mirrorByte(cBuf[i]));    }    xPosCenter += 2;     text++;  }  // 3. PANAH ATAS (Kanan - Modul 4)  if (arrowMode == 1) {     int16_t xPosRight = (MAX_DEVICES * 8) - 6; // Berada di area kolom 26-30    for (uint8_t i = 0; i < sizeof(iconUp_Small); i++) {      uint8_t colData = pgm_read_byte(&iconUp_Small[i]);      mx.setColumn((MAX_DEVICES * 8) - 1 - (xPosRight + i), mirrorByte(colData));    }  }}void loop() {  int speedVal = random(30, 41);   char displayStr[5];  itoa(speedVal, displayStr, 10);   uint8_t arrowMode = 0;   if (speedVal > 38)      arrowMode = 2; // Speed > 38 -> Panah Bawah (?)  else if (speedVal < 35) arrowMode = 1; // Speed < 35 -> Panah Atas (?)  updateHUD(displayStr, arrowMode);    delay(3000); }

Pembuatan Report Fatigue Ratio
description:
cara menghitungnya adalahjumlah orang yang upload di setiap tanggal , per distrikdibandingkan dengan data result OPA yang scorenya >= 9;
CREATE VIEW vw_upload_fatigue_ratio ASWITH Fatigue AS(    SELECT        distrik,        CAST(tanggal AS DATE) AS tanggal,        COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_fatigue    FROM db_opa.dbo.tbl_t_ftw_result_opa WITH (NOLOCK)    WHERE total_score >= 9      AND distrik <> 'JIEP'    GROUP BY        distrik,        CAST(tanggal AS DATE)),Upload AS(    SELECT        distrik,        CAST(created_date AS DATE) AS tanggal,        COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_upload    FROM db_opa.dbo.tbl_t_ftw_jam_tidur_harian WITH (NOLOCK)    WHERE jam_upload <> '-'      AND distrik <> 'JIEP'    GROUP BY        distrik,        CAST(created_date AS DATE))SELECT    F.distrik,    F.tanggal,    F.total_fatigue,    ISNULL(U.total_upload, 0) AS total_upload,    CAST(        F.total_fatigue * 1.0        / NULLIF(U.total_upload, 0)        AS DECIMAL(10,4)    ) AS ratioFROM Fatigue FLEFT JOIN Upload U    ON  U.distrik = F.distrik    AND U.tanggal = F.tanggal--ORDER BY--    F.tanggal,--    F.distrik;
